dedupe_keys.name: bts bikeshare docked and dockless and e scooter systems by year and city served

description: This Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) dataset lists the cities served by a bikeshare or e-scooter system in each year from 2015. Bikeshare covers systems that are open to the public, IT-automated and station based, and dockless systems. Coverage: the United States, one row per primary city and year, with the number of docking stations, the number of dockless bikeshare systems and the number of e-scooter systems serving the city, the system names, launch and closure dates, notes, a mid-year (July) snapshot, city coordinates and county FIPS codes. Some systems serve more than one city, but only the primary city is listed, and counts include systems that served an area for only part of the year. Format and access: a Socrata table with CSV export, an API and a map layer. Licence and cost: public domain, free. Caveats: it records which systems exist, not their trips or fleet sizes, and secondary cities of a system are not listed. The inventory can be used to choose study cities and to set which shared modes exist in agent-based or network flow models of urban travel. It relates to the General Bikeshare Feed Specification, Citi Bike data and Capital Bikeshare data in the catalogue.
